subject: Remediation validation pack and next scan window
messages:
From: Jen Morris <jen@acme-pay.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Security Team <security@acme-pay.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: validation pack + upcoming scan window for CVE-2027-0156

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, Acme Pay needs a compact "remediation validation pack" we can use for our internal audit and for SOC 2 evidence. Specifically we need:

- A short manifest of applied patches for the impacted components (kernel, container base images).
- A summary of the post-patch vulnerability scan (tool, version, scan date/time, and high/critical counts).
- A remediation matrix mapping CVE IDs -> patch/PR numbers -> owner -> verification status.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide those artifacts by end of day Tuesday (our timezone)? Also, we want to schedule the next full host/container scan window — ideally Thursday morning PDT — so we can validate the closure and sign off.

One note: our compliance team will expect an explicit statement that CVE-2027-0156 is closed to exploit by configuration and patch; if you can include a short attestation line that would help.

Attached is a template our SOC 2 auditor prefers (for formatting).

Thanks,
Jen
Jen Morris
Senior Information Security Manager
Acme Pay

[Attachment: acme_audit_template.docx]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Jen Morris <jen@acme-pay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 09:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: validation pack + upcoming scan window for CVE-2027-0156

Jen — thanks for the clear list. We can produce the requested artifacts and I’ve looped in Marissa (security operations) and Ben (vuln engineering) to prepare the files. Quick plan: 

1) I will assemble a compact remediation manifest (CSV) and provide an attestation statement confirming the patch & mitigation steps applied for CVE-2027-0156.
2) Ben will drop the raw scan summary and the scan metadata (tool/version, signature timestamp).
3) Marissa will produce the remediation_matrix.xlsx mapping CVEs -> commits/PRs -> verification steps and final status.

Can you confirm the Thursday morning PDT scan window — we’ll propose Thursday 2027-06-29 08:00–10:00 PDT for the full host/container sweep. If that works we’ll schedule and share the scan job ID.

I’ve attached the preliminary patch_manifest.csv (internal stub) — it's an export from our change system with the commit IDs and rollout windows. We’ll follow up with the scan PDF and filled remediation matrix tomorrow.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: patch_manifest.csv]

On Sun, Jun 27, 2027 at 09:12 AM Jen Morris <jen@acme-pay.com> wrote:
> Hi Kimberly,
> 
> Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, Acme Pay needs a compact "remediation validation pack"...

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: validation pack + upcoming scan window for CVE-2027-0156

Kim / Marissa — quick update from vuln engineering:

- Scan run: RedwoodScan v3.4.1; job id RS-20270628-8842; started 2027-06-28T09:48:00-07:00; finished 2027-06-28T09:59:40-07:00.
- Findings: 0 critical, 1 high (container image libcurl CVE-2027-0199) — that one has a backported fix applied and is pending canary verification; will be closed prior to the Thursday window.
- CVE-2027-0156: fixed in commit 7f2d1c3, rolled to 3/3 prod clusters (rollout complete), mitigations verified in host configs.

I attached the raw scan_summary.pdf and included the scan manifest in the remediation_matrix.xlsx. I'll add a short verification note for each row (manual validation steps we ran).

Ben
Ben Carter
Vulnerability Engineering Lead
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: scan_summary.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jen Morris <jen@acme-pay.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: validation pack + upcoming scan window for CVE-2027-0156

Jen — attaching the final remediation_matrix.xlsx and the consolidated scan_summary.pdf. Per your auditor template we included:

- A one-line attestation: "Redwood Inference confirms CVE-2027-0156 has been remediated via patch (commit 7f2d1c3) and mitigated configuration; verification completed on 2027-06-28 09:59:40 -07:00."
- Scan metadata table (tool, signature, job id RS-20270628-8842).
- Mapping of all referenced CVEs (IDs, patch commits, PR links, owner, verification status).

We will schedule the full scan for the proposed slot on Thursday 2027-06-29 08:00 PDT and will share the job id and results as soon as it completes. Please let us know if Acme needs any additional notarized artifacts (signed letter) for SOC 2 — we can provide a brief signed PDF if requested.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Security Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

[Attachments: remediation_matrix.xlsx, scan_summary.pdf]
